syncedOn: 2026-09-26 (primitives moved to their own collection the same day)

batches.content: color/palette, radius, border, focus, size, typography dimensions, layer, opacity

migrations.change: Primitives moved from the Brand collection (VariableID:4:5 to 4:228, removed) to the new Primitives collection (VariableID:14:3 to 14:226); 560 aliases re-pointed by name; no node was bound to the old variables.

Density collection default mode set to standard (mode 4:6) with setDefaultMode; the mode order became standard, compact, comfortable. Appearance already defaulted to light, Brand to base. Matches the defaults of foundations/config.json; the sync script now sets default modes from the manifest.

variables.note: Variables are matched by collection and name; the sync script preserves IDs. The exact name to ID map is read from the file with a read-only script before any migration (rename, removal, type change).

additions.note: radius.focus (base alias primitive/radius/lg, brick primitive/radius/sm, orchid literal 14), scope CORNER_RADIUS, code syntax var(--ggb-radius-focus); resolution checked in the three brands (8, 4, 14).

limitations: OpenType features (tnum on typography/numeral/*) cannot be set on text styles through the Plugin API; the style description records them and the text layer sets them.
Style IDs are file-local (S:… keys) and are read from the file when needed.
